<b>Hardbone Hoppers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are grazing creatures with sharp senses who are not overcome with aggression despite being [[Haunting|haunted]].<ref>Hardbone Hopper [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Grazing creature with sharp senses that nimbly retreats from danger.<br>Despite the Haunting of its shell, it has not been overcome with aggression. Its desire to flee remains too strong."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Hops around aimlessly, turning around once it reaches a wall or at random, largely ignoring its surroundings. Occasionally pauses for a moment before resuming hopping. While it does not attack, it still deals contact damage.<br>
It should be noted that they do not take any knockback from Hornet's attacks.<br>
Hardbone Hoppers respawn upon re-entering the room, making getting their Hunter's Journal entry much easier.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Hardbone Hoppers have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* World's breath, rustling leaf...
* Hard bone beneath...
* Roaming, feeding, distant depths...
* Mark of circle, mark of death...
}}

== Location ==
Four Hardbone Hoppers can be found in the northeast [[Deep Docks]], and one of them, on the far right side of the room, disappears once [[Cling Grip]] has been acquired.

In [[Act 3]], a few more can be found in the northern [[Far Fields]], in the areas north and east of [[Pilgrim's Rest]] that are accessible from [[Hunter's March]] with the [[Silk Soar]]; they are also accompanied by three [[Hardbone Elder]]s.
